p1: My new house came with a bell above the bedroom door. At 3 a.m., something rings it.
Its string runs through the floor, into the basement dirt.
The old owner, Walter, left a note: Keep the bell. It helps me sleep.
Creepy fact: old graves had a bell, tied to the dead person's finger, in case they woke up.
Every night, my bell rang. Like something down there was pulling.
Two weeks of no sleep. I cut it.
Next morning, my neighbour Frank saw the cut string. He went white.
You cut it? Walter slept fine. While it rang, he knew where it was.
Tonight at 3, no bell. Just footsteps on the basement stairs.
I'm in my car now, watching my bedroom light.
